name: Cubing Simple in Temple 2025

venue.name: Frank W. Mayborn Civic & Convention Center

information:
Note: This competition is on a Sunday

- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingSimpleinTemple2025#54265-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingSimpleinTemple2025#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 

This competition is part of the WCA Newcomer Month 2025. If you are new to competing, this would be a great competition to be your first! Please review the [Newcomer Month](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingSimpleinTemple2025#54271-newcomer-month) tab for more information.
